title: PromptVerse — AI Prompt Sharing & Marketplace Platform
description: A modern full-stack AI Prompt Sharing & Marketplace Platform where users can discover, share, bookmark, review, and monetize high-quality AI prompts for tools like ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Midjourney, and more. Features robust dashboards for Users, Creators, and Admins with analytics, moderation tools, payment management, and role-based access control.
challenges: Managing complex state handling and real-time synchronization securely across protected client routes and role-based dashboards.
Integrating secure one-time Stripe payment transactions and handling backend session/JWT validation seamlessly.
improvements: Integrating advanced automated unit and integration testing pipelines.
Expanding multi-language support and deep analytics dashboards with custom reporting features.

title: Auto Hive — Car Rental Platform
description: A modern and responsive full-stack car rental platform where users can explore available cars, view detailed car information, book vehicles, manage bookings, and add their own car listings securely.
challenges: Handling date-range availability conflicts and database queries efficiently for overlapping vehicle bookings.
Ensuring responsive layout design across various mobile and desktop viewports with dynamic filtering states.
improvements: Adding a real-time chat feature between vehicle owners and renters.
Implementing interactive maps for pickup and drop-off locations.

title: EventHub — Premium Event Management Platform
description: An elegant, modern, and production-ready full-stack event management web application built with the MERN Stack, TypeScript, and Next.js, featuring Apple-inspired minimalism and real-time data analytics.
challenges: Configuring strict TypeScript interfaces across complex API requests and state management components.
Optimizing dashboard rendering performance while dealing with heavy statistical data sets visualized via Recharts.
improvements: Introducing email notification reminders for upcoming booked events using an external queue service.
Adding export functionality for attendee reports in PDF and CSV formats.

title: NextJourney — Full Stack Agentic AI Application
description: A production-ready, full-stack Agentic AI application built with Next.js, TypeScript, and Node.js, integrating advanced AI capabilities with secure authentication and a responsive UI.
challenges: Managing asynchronous streaming responses from language models while maintaining a smooth and interactive user interface.
Handling rate limits and optimizing token usage patterns across user requests securely on the backend.
improvements: Implementing user history tracking with conversation branching support.
Adding support for multi-modal inputs including image analysis prompts.

title: Marbello — Modern Tile Gallery
description: A premium, responsive tile gallery web app featuring dynamic search, detailed views, and secure user management for aesthetic tile collections.
challenges: Integrating BetterAuth smoothly with Next.js route handlers and managing session persistence securely.
Optimizing high-resolution image grids and assets to ensure an Apple-like smooth minimal UI aesthetic.
improvements: Adding a customized sample-ordering cart and checkout workflow for clients.
Introducing advanced filter options based on texture, finish, and dimension dimensions.
